citations.excerpt: THIRTY YEARS’ WAR (1618–1648), the general name of a series of wars in Germany which began formally with the claim of Frederick the elector palatine to the throne of Bohemia and ended with the treaty of Westphalia.

facts.value: Treaty that ended the Thirty Years' War and set the basis of ecclesiastical affairs in the Empire on the conditions of 1624.

citations.excerpt: ended with the treaty of Westphalia.
The Treaty of Westphalia (1648) established as the basis of ecclesiastical affairs the conditions of the year 1624.
